title: 1969 Moon Radio, Subtitled by AI 🌕

segments.text: Crackly 1969 radio. *Subtitled by a free AI.*
75 seconds of radio, subtitled in *22 seconds.* Offline, on a CPU.
segments.say: Seventy five seconds of Apollo radio, subtitled in twenty two seconds. Offline, on a normal CPU.

segments.text: It even catches *the 1201 alarm.* Wait for the landing.
How: it's called *faster-whisper.* 4 lines of Python.
segments.say: It's called faster-whisper. Install it, and a few lines of Python turn any video into subtitles.

segments.text: *Save this.* Send it to someone who edits videos.
segments.say: Save this, and send it to someone who edits videos.
